canonicalFacts.claim: ADHD affects approximately 3% of adults globally
Methylphenidate is the most frequently used medication to treat ADHD in children and adolescents
ADHD is associated with increased risks of adverse health outcomes including premature death
Among untreated adults, functional impairments associated with ADHD are widespread and cumulative
Several nonstimulants including atomoxetine and viloxazine extended-release are approved by the FDA for ADHD treatment

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Physical exercise shows potential benefits for children with ADHD and may improve cognitive function
Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids have potential benefits that seem to outweigh known risks

redFlags: ADHD medications may be associated with cardiovascular effects including changes in blood pressure and heart rate
Stimulant medications carry a risk of misuse and dependence
ADHD is associated with increased mortality risk
